epithet: The White Hawk · leader of the Band of the Hawk
question: He wanted a kingdom of his own, and everyone who loved him was the price. What does each half of that wear?
why_en: Valaya Exclusif is the dream: almond and bergamot into orange blossom and white flowers, closing on white musk and vanilla — immaculate, aristocratic, the castle a commoner was never meant to want.
why_ar: وذا مون هو الكسوف: زعفرانٌ وتوتٌ أحمر فوق الورد التركي واللبان، نزولًا إلى العود والجلد والسيبريول — الفاكهة الحمراء تُقرأ دمًا، والجلد هو ما بقي من الحلم.
